title: Sirocco private deploy weekly sync — agenda & action log (prep)
content:
Purpose: prep notes for weekly sync with Sirocco (customer) on private deployment (VPC + on‑prem agent). Goal = unblock staging rollout, confirm data-plane networking, finalize maintenance window for blue/green, and own next steps.

Meeting details (target):
- Time: Tuesday 2026-03-16 10:30 PT (30m) — confirm with Sirocco ops (preferred mornings)
- Attendees (internal): Amelia (owner), Samir (networking lead), Nina (infra eng), Ralph (SRE/observability).
- Attendees (customer): Javier (SRE), Priya (security), Mark (platform), ops lead TBD.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick status (5m) — what shipped since last sync (staging infra, agent v2.3).
2) Network & routing (8m) — VPC peering / NAT rules, service CIDR overlap check, egress for model downloads.
3) Rolling window & fallbacks (7m) — agree on maintenance window for canary -> full cutover; rollback plan.
4) Blockers & owners (7m) — prioritize items that block production rollout.
5) Action review + next meeting (3m).

Prep notes / facts to confirm before meeting:
- Staging cluster: agent v2.3 deployed to 3 nodes in customer data center; acceptance tests pass except long-tail latency on 4096 tokens. (Nina)
- Model artifacts: large quantized blob (12.6GB) hosted in customer S3. Need signed temporary URL for node download. (Javier asked for presigned URLs)
- Network: customer VPC uses 10.0.0.0/16; our recommended service CIDR is 172.31.0.0/16 — potential overlap flagged earlier. Samir to confirm exact subnets in use.
- KMS/HSM: Priya asked for HSM fingerprint validation; we have sample verify script in Confluence.

Open blockers (current):
1) NAT/egress for model download failing in some staging nodes — symptomatic of missing route to S3 endpoint. Repro steps in SIR-412. Owner: Samir. Need: confirmed route, or alternative presigned download via customer bastion. Target date: 2026-03-10 (blocked, moved).
2) Agent memory regression on v2.3 under long sequences (p95 mem spikes) — causes OOM on node-3 intermittently. Owner: Nina. Need: heap dump + init flags tuning. Target: 2026-03-14 for hotfix.
3) TLS mutual auth between customer control-plane and our agent failing for one node (cert chain mismatch). Owner: Amelia (coordinate with Priya & Javier). Need: confirm CA bundle, push updated certs. Target: 2026-03-12 (attempted).
4) Observability: traces not showing per-request token counts (affects billing reconciliation). Owner: Ralph. Need: enable token-count exporter and confirm ingestion to Splunk. Target: 2026-03-13.

Risk notes / mitigation suggestions (for meeting):
- If model download cannot be stabilized quickly, propose temporary use of smaller quantized variant (7.2GB) for canary traffic; we should have parity tests to check quality impact.
- For OOM risk, suggest reducing canary concurrency to 1 instance until hotfix landed.
- For cert issue, we should have an emergency fallback: allow short-lived unsecured bootstrap via customer bastion for downloads only (audit and limit).

Decisions needed from customer during sync:
- Confirm maintenance window: 3 hours on Saturday, 02:00–05:00 local (customer timezone) OR prefer weekday low-traffic window.
- Approve using smaller quantized model for initial canary if download issues persist.
- Provide final list of CIDR ranges allowed for our control-plane egress.

Action items (explicit, owner, date):
- Samir: get full VPC subnet map + NAT/gateway config from Javier; validate route to S3 or present workaround (bastion presigned URL). Due: 2026-03-12.
- Nina: capture heap dumps from node-3, try mem-tuning flags (--gpu-cache-size) and report results; open PR for agent config change if stable. Due: 2026-03-14.
- Amelia: re-issue updated cert bundle to Priya, run mutual-auth validation script, and log results in SIR-412. Due: 2026-03-12 EOD.
- Ralph: enable token-count exporter in staging, add dashboards (token burn + latency) and confirm Splunk ingestion. Due: 2026-03-13.
- Amelia: draft email to customer with proposed maintenance windows and quality tradeoffs (smaller model option) — include rollback plan. Due: 2026-03-11 morning.

Notes to self (things to bring up / risk wording):
- Be explicit about cost implications of switching quantization: show expected latency + PU (processing unit) cost delta for 7.2GB vs 12.6GB model. (short table in meeting notes).
- Ask Javier whether customer can temporarily zone-replicate model artifacts to a local S3 endpoint inside their datacenter to reduce cross‑network bandwidth.
- Confirm who signs off on maintenance window (ops manager vs platform lead). Escalation path: Priya -> Mark.
- Remind SREs to run the post-deployment smoke script (confluence link) immediately after canary cutover.

Quick draft of email body to send post-meeting (Amelia will finalize):
"Thanks all — summary + actions attached. We need confirmation on: maintenance window (X), CIDR ranges (Y), and approval to use smaller quantized model for canary if needed. Samir/Nina/Ralph will update tickets with progress by dates noted.

If we don't have routes for S3 by Thursday EOD, propose delaying full rollout and running a reduced-concurrency canary on Friday"

Prep checklist for sync (tick during meeting):
- [ ] Confirm attendee list and escalation contacts.
- [ ] Samir presents VPC map and current route state.
- [ ] Nina shows mem profiles and steps taken.
- [ ] Ralph verifies telemetry availability.
- [ ] Customer approves one of proposed maintenance windows.

Later follow-ups to schedule after this meeting:
- Deep-dive with customer security (Priya) to finalize HSM/KMS integration and audit log format (1-hour). Owner: Amelia.
- Post-mortem if OOM persists after hotfix (include allocation traces). Owner: Nina.

Random notes / friction items to avoid in meeting (keep short):
- Avoid long architecture lecture — customer wants concrete next steps and dates.
- Keep canary quality discussion focused on measurable evals (latency, hallucination rate) not theoretical tradeoffs.

Next meeting proposal: weekly cadence Tuesdays 10:30 PT; add an optional tech deep-dive on Thursdays if tickets remain open.

-- End of prep scratchpad --

(Will convert to cleaned meeting minutes after sync and paste links to updated JIRA and Confluence pages.)
